subject: Offer freeze and reorg requests: temporary pause on select bands
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Offer freeze and reorg requests: temporary pause on select bands

Team,

Quick note — Finance completed a mid-quarter review this morning and flagged headcount run-rate risk if we proceed with all outstanding offers as-is. Attached is a strawman redistribution (headcount_realloc_v3.xlsx) that shifts 6 open IC requisitions from general product to infra (3) and sales (3) over the next two quarters.

Ask: I propose a temporary pause on new offer acceptances for L3–L5 IC roles (exceptions below) until we lock the Q3 commit. Practically that means:
- Recruiters stop sending new offer packages to candidates in those bands for 72 hours (we already have a couple in late-stage).
- Continue through for any roles flagged as production-critical (infra) or quota-bearing sales reps — those go through an expedited CFO/People approval.
- We’ll finalize band deltas and any comp uplifts in the attached PDF (offer_guidelines_deltas.pdf) after leadership signoff.

Please reply with:
1) Rapid confirmation you can pause outbound offers for the affected bands.
2) Any candidate in-flight requiring an exception (name + stage).

I’d like a decision recorded by EOD Monday so recruiters have clear instructions.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: headcount_realloc_v3.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer freeze and reorg requests: temporary pause on select bands

Aditya —

I support a short, surgical pause. Important caveats:
- Sales quota hires (we have two AE reqs open in EMEA and one in US) are time-sensitive — losing pipeline will cost more than holding one or two offers.
- We should preserve the hiring for Customer Success manager in APAC (already verbal offer).

Monica — can you pull a quick list of offers that are verbal/contract-signed and flag those that absolutely can’t be paused?

If Finance needs this recorded, I can sign off on exceptions for quota-bearing roles so it doesn’t block revenue hires.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Cc: Sara Thompson <sara@capstone-recruit.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer freeze and reorg requests: temporary pause on select bands

Team,

Summary of in-flight offers (current snapshot):
- Jordan Kramer (Senior Backend Engineer, L4) — offer verbal, counter expected this week, start target 8/2.
- AE US (Cindy Morales) — offer sent, pending signature, start target 7/26.
- CS APAC (Rina Shah) — verbal accepted, paperwork in DocuSign, start 7/19.
- Two L3 SWE interns (university hires) — offers scheduled to go out next week.

Per Aditya’s note: if we pause now, candidates with verbal acceptances will need outreach. I’ve attached the proposed offer guideline deltas (offer_guidelines_deltas.pdf) — it includes recommended language for a short pause and a goodwill gesture (one-time sign-on credit) if we need to defer.

For external recruiter Sara: please hold any new outbound offers for L3–L5 until I confirm, and send me any candidate who says they have an imminent competing offer.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer_guidelines_deltas.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer freeze and reorg requests: temporary pause on select bands

Thanks for the clear notes. I’ve reviewed the headcount sheet. Decision:

1) Effective immediately, pause issuance of any new offer letters and pause acceptance for L3–L5 IC bands unless an exception is formally approved.
2) Exceptions allowed (fast-path approval via email to me and Laura):
   • Production-critical infra roles (as labelled in the attached spreadsheet).
   • Quota-bearing revenue hires (AE/SDR/AM) where immediate ramp is demonstrably revenue-protecting.
3) Recruiters should reach out to candidates with verbal accepts and explain we need 3–5 business days to confirm timing; offer a token sign-on credit if delay exceeds 7 business days.
4) Legal/People: hold any DocuSign sends that are routine. For candidates with signed contracts, treat on a case-by-case basis.

I’ll record this in the headcount tracker and notify Finance. Please implement and report back on a short list of exceptions by EOD Wednesday.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
